description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters   We are seeking a hands-on technical leader for the DET IT Finance Engineering team with experience building solutions for cloud ERP platforms such as Workday, Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, or comparable systems.   This role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in ERP technical development, enterprise integrations, or data engineering. Our environment includes Workday Financials, MuleSoft, cloud platforms, and financial data solutions. You will help shape their architecture, build reliable solutions, and apply AI and automation to improve engineering productivity and finance operations.  Candidates may bring their strongest expertise in Workday technical engineering, MuleSoft or comparable integration platforms, or data platforms supporting cloud ERP. The ability to design, code, troubleshoot, and lead complex technical delivery is central to this role.   As a Lead Software Engineer, you will drive the design and delivery of enterprise finance solutions that power Salesforce globally. You will work across ERP applications, APIs, integrations, and data platforms to solve complex business and engineering problems. You will remain actively involved in implementation while guiding architecture, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, and improving platform reliability. You should be comfortable learning new technologies and applying your experience across platforms, including Workday.      Core Responsibilities & Scope     Define technical architecture across cloud ERP, integration, and data platforms, establishing standards for security, scalability, maintainability, and performance.  Design, build, and operate integrations connecting Workday and other finance applications with Salesforce, revenue recognition, tax, banking, and enterprise data platforms.  Develop solutions using your primary technical strengths—ERP development, MuleSoft/API engineering, or data engineering—and collaborate across the other disciplines.  Build reliable APIs, event-driven integrations, data pipelines, and transformations with appropriate validation, reconciliation, error handling, and monitoring.  Lead complex troubleshooting across application, integration, and data layers, addressing root causes and improving operational resilience.  Modernize existing solutions using appropriate cloud services, automation, and reusable engineering components.  Apply AI-assisted development and agentic tools to coding, testing, documentation, and support, with attention to accuracy, security, and measurable value.  Own technical delivery from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.  Mentor engineers through design and code reviews and partner with product, finance, architecture, security, and platform teams.      Minimum Requirements     10+ years of enterprise software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on technical delivery involving a cloud ERP platform such as Workday, Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, NetSuite, or a comparable platform.  Demonstrated technical depth in at least one of the following areas:    ERP technical engineering: Extensions, integrations, business-process automation, security, reporting, or accounting/data-processing frameworks.  Integration engineering: MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or comparable technologies, including API development, orchestration, messaging, and enterprise system connectivity.  Data engineering: Advanced SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformation frameworks, and cloud data platforms supporting ERP or financial processes.    Strong hands-on programming skills in languages relevant to your specialization, such as Java, Python, SQL, or equivalent, with the ability to write, review, debug, and optimize production code.  Proven experience leading architecture and solution design for complex enterprise systems.  Strong understanding of APIs, REST/SOAP services, authentication, asynchronous processing, and integration design patterns.  Experience designing for data integrity, reconciliation, auditability, security, and reliable recovery from failures.  Practical experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring.  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across applications, integrations, and databases.  A related technical degree required.   Ability to translate finance requirements into technical solutions and explain design decisions to technical and business stakeholders.  Willingness to develop expertise in Workday and the broader finance technology stack.      Preferred Qualifications     Hands-on Workday technical experience in one or more areas such as Financials, Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Extend, Orchestrate, reporting, or security.  Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including API development, DataWeave, API Management, and CloudHub.  Experience building and operating solutions on AWS, GCP, or another major cloud platform.  Familiarity with finance processes such as general ledger, accounts receivable/payable, revenue recognition, tax, payments, or financial close.  Experience with event-driven architectures using Kafka, Pub/Sub, SQS, or equivalent technologies.  Experience applying AI developer tools, LLMs, or agentic automation to enterprise engineering workflows.  Understanding of SOX controls, enterprise security, and finance-system governance.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.       In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits.  Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Datacenter Automation Platforms
description_html: Collaborate with NVIDIA professionals responsible for building the platforms that operate AI factories at scale. We drive product roadmaps, architecture, multi-functional alignment, and implementation across multiple open source and internal-facing products.   We partner with executive leadership to align platform strategy and drive adoption of innovative approaches to software development across engineering teams. Our team mentors engineering talent and turns successful domain solutions into reusable platform capabilities used across the organization.    What you'll be doing:    Build self-service SDKs, workflow templates, reference implementations, and a catalog of reusable agents, tools, and connectors. Prioritize automation by customer impact, frequency, operational risk, and encouraged reduction in human effort.    Translate operational intent into versioned, testable policies that define triggers, prerequisites, permitted actions, approval requirements, maintenance windows, capacity limits, and recovery or blocking issue paths.    Define common contracts for tools, state, events, and workflow execution. Establish versioning and compatibility standards, guide migration from fragmented implementations to shared services, and select the runtime and durable execution architecture.  Build agents that correlate hardware diagnostics, logs, metrics, topology, configuration, and incident history to investigate failures, propose evidence-backed diagnoses, and produce executable remediation plans. Enforce authorization independently of model output, retain action histories, and support human review, bounded retries, cancellation, and compensating actions.  Automate provisioning validation, node quarantine, workload-aware maintenance, repair, upgrades, and return to service. Integrate with Kubernetes, fleet management systems, and relevant schedulers and hardware interfaces.  Tackle fleet-scale problems including partial failures, duplicate events, stale state, conflicting remediations, noisy telemetry, control-plane bottlenecks, and correlated rack or cluster failures.  Establish shared evaluation, CI/CD, staged rollout, and observability capabilities across teams.  Drive cross-team adoption through build reviews, migration plans, documentation, and hands-on partnership.   Align infrastructure, networking, storage, security, and workload teams on shared priorities and contribution standards.     What we need to see:    8+ years of experience in software engineering or a related field.  BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience.  Expert level knowledge of a systems programming language (Go, Python, and/or Rust) and a solid understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms.  Strong background in Linux system administration and management.  Experience handling cluster orchestration tools, including Kubernetes and/or SLURM.    Understanding of software development patterns dedicated to agents and current security practices for agentic systems.    Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems, including system-level architecture, data synchronization, fault tolerance, and state management.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Experience with open source software projects, licensing, and governance.  Proficiency in understanding and managing large-scale distributed systems independently of cloud providers.  Deep knowledge of datacenter operations and GPU hardware.  Advanced hands-on experience with cluster management systems (Kubernetes, SLURM).  Hands-on experience in Machine Learning Operations, Training, and/or Security fields.      #LI-Hybrid     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 14, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
